title: Effect of Process Parameters on Properties of Cold-Sprayed Zn–Al Composite Coatings
InformationInFigures: Yes. Powder morphology (Fig. 1), Raster pattern (Fig. 2), microstructure features (Fig. 4,5,6), coating thickness (Fig. 8, 10, 12) microhardness (Fig. 13, 14, 15)

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Chemical_Composition: 0.03 wt% Si, 0.058 wt% Fe, 0.001 wt% Cu, Bal. Al
preSprayedProperties.Secondary_Powder_Chemical_Composition: 0.006 wt% Fe, 0.004 wt% Cd, 0.004 wt% Pb, Bal. Zn
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Blend_Ratio: 3:1 mass ratio of aluminum to zinc powder
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: both powders are mostly spherical. aluminum has satellite particles.
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: zinc powder size ranged from 5 to 30 μm
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: mixed powder was dried for 2h in a vacuum-drying oven at 90°C, followed by 1h of mechanical mixing.
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Material_Composition: 0.15 wt% C, 0.5 wt% Mn, 0.2 wt% Si, 0.2 wt% S, 0.03 wt% P, Bal. Fe
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: treated with sandpaper and cleaned with alcohol

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: obviously more Al (gray-yellow area) than Zn (white area). more defects compared to samples made at 550°C, particle deformation degree weakened.
